name: PaperForge PageNet v2 (opt-in)
origin: Original MobileNetV3-Small-layout U-Net (width 1.5), trained from random initialisation by scripts/train_page_models.py; no third-party weights.
trainingData: Procedural sheets and scenes (scripts/page_scenes.py, scripts/realistic_scenes.py) over COCO val2017 photographs or procedural surfaces; 25% of batches were photographs from 'A New Image Dataset for Document Corner Localization' (Mendeley Data x3nm4cxr83, CC BY 4.0), training groups only.
selection: Checkpoint and threshold chosen on real photographs: half of the SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 1 test documents (ICDAR 2015, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.1230218, CC BY 4.0) and half of 'Labeled receipt images' (Auad et al., Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13688441, CC BY 4.0). The other halves, public167 and the owner photos were used only to report results.
attribution: SmartDoc 2015 Challenge 1, Burie et al., ICDAR 2015 (CC BY 4.0)
Auad, Alves, Kakizaki, Reis, Silva: Labeled receipt images, Zenodo 2024 (CC BY 4.0)
note: Opt-in engine PAGENET_V2. Results and open issues: docs/development/DETECTION-RESEARCH-2026-11.md
